Persons, not images; the person key is the built split's. With sex = persons with a recorded female or male value; "other" and "unknown" codes are excluded from the female denominator (CTSpinoPelvic1K 11, VinDr-SpineXR 68 studies, COBRA2026 120 of 692). CTSpinoPelvic1K ages of 89 are the TCIA top-code (31 records). NHANES II releases no demographics with its films; the sequence number in each file name joins the survey's public-use anthropometry tape, whose sex code was checked against median standing height. VinDr-SpineXR releases no table; both tags were read from every image header and no study's images disagreed. The COBRA2026 and NHANES II rows are given for the cases Table 1 counts and for the whole release. IQR = interquartile range; TCIA = The Cancer Imaging Archive; CDC = Centers for Disease Control and Prevention.
